items.q: so Wally said, 'Well, we're happy to have you with the family and I hope you're happy.'

ctx.x: Yeah, so that's what I was thinking, you know, so this guy said -- so Wally said, 'Well, we're happy to have you with the family and I hope you're happy.' So Sammy said, 'Oh, we're happy, but we could be happier.' So Wally said, 'Well, what do you mean by that, you could be happier?' He said, 'Well, if that 4 percent was moved up to 5 percent.' He said, 'Yeah, but you've got a contract.' So he says, 'Oh, but you said that if I could be happier, you know. You said you hope I'm happy. I said yeah, but I could be…
You know, well that is really --
